tasks.short: Collaborate on teaching and research issues

steps.what: Locate the teaching and research materials relevant to colleagues' issue
Prepare a written contribution for colleagues' teaching or research discussion
Share the prepared contribution with participating colleagues
Collaborate with colleagues to resolve the issues and agree actions

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} and {LMS} search views to find relevant materials and a short contribution template with source references. The teacher writes the substance, checks the exact contribution before sharing and retains the collaborative discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current materials and restating background can occupy preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved views and reusable source headings can remove some lookup and repeated background typing.
tasks.still_hard: Colleagues must negotiate different research and teaching priorities.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the issue and build agreement with colleagues.
tasks.altitude: Prepare collaboration with clearer sources while preserving the conversation.

reach.learn: Share the source material before discussing possible changes.

evidence.claim: Native search views and contribution headings can reduce lookup and repeated background typing; the time estimates are an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: This scenario is a current collaboration that already uses a written contribution read by colleagues; it does not add meeting minutes or a trailing activity log. Purely oral collaboration has no eligible writing baseline.

Colleagues produce the issue and participant list in their existing request. Course owners maintain source materials. S1 includes locating and checking the correct versions; missing sources require manual search.

The 3-hour lookup reduction removes repeated navigation, while the separate 3-hour contribution reduction removes repeated headings and background references; substantive argument remains written by the teacher.
Use native document and course views first. Ordinary author saves remain retained and ungated.
unknowns: Whether a written contribution is actually used in current collaborations.
How much current background text is reusable.
research_questions: Observe several issue discussions and time existing preparation and source lookup without adding documentation.

already_counted.description: Read sources and write the substantive contribution

incremental.description: Maintain source links and contribution headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact discussion contribution, attachments and colleague recipients; edits or recipient changes require a new check before sharing.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=94, gross 6 minus 1 upkeep gives central net 5. Conservative case: poorly indexed source versions retain all 15 lookup hours and a bespoke contribution retains 19/20 writing hours; 99 retained, 1 gross minus 1 =0. With usable source metadata and some reusable background, retain 13 lookup and 18 contribution hours plus 65 other hours: 96 retained, 4 gross minus 1 =3. No written contribution means no writing benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Support student recruitment, registration and placement

steps.what: Check current programme, registration and placement information
Participate in recruitment conversations and explain the programme
outputs: programme explanations given to prospective students

steps.what: Discuss registration choices and resolve student questions
Enter the registration details handled by the teacher
Assess placement suitability and discuss available options
Write the placement recommendation in the existing student record
Communicate the registration and placement outcome to the student

tasks.design: Configure native views and registration defaults in the existing student information system ({OTHER}), linked to current programme information in {LMS}. Keep recruitment conversations and placement judgement with the teacher, and reduce repeated registration fields while retaining the substantive placement recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programme lookup and repeated student/course fields can sit alongside personal recruitment and placement work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and prefilled registration fields can remove repeated navigation and typing.
tasks.still_hard: Placement depends on the student's circumstances and available opportunities.
tasks.human_edge: Explain options and assess individual suitability without automatic admission or placement ranking.
tasks.altitude: Separate student support from repeated administration across successive stages.

reach.learn: Reuse verified student identity and current course information.

evidence.claim: Native student record views and registration defaults could reduce repeated administrative work; individual placement judgement is retained and savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing student information system. The baseline covers the teacher's current registration entries and written placement recommendation used by student services; it does not invent central admissions work.

Programme and registration staff maintain programme identifiers, rules and published placement information. The student provides identity and choices, clarified in s3, while the teacher produces the placement recommendation in s5. S1, s3 and retained s4/s6 time include source checks and capture; missing fields are entered manually.

The lookup cut removes 3 hours of navigation. Registration defaults remove 6 hours of repeated identity/course typing. Placement writing loses only 1 hour of repeated headings because its individual rationale remains substantive.
No automatic selection, capacity alert or communication is implied. Author saves in s4 and s6 remain retained without self-approval.
unknowns: Which entries the teacher currently makes rather than central student services.
Whether existing student views already prefill identity and course details.
research_questions: Follow a recruitment-to-placement case and measure the teacher's actual entry and lookup time at each phase.

already_counted.description: Clarify choices and assess placement suitability

incremental.description: Keep programme views and registration defaults current

approvals.approved_version: Exact programme statements and material presented to the current audience; check current facts before giving an explanation or correction.
Exact student recipient, registration details and placement wording; changes require a new check before sending.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=90, gross 10 minus 2 upkeep gives central net 8. Conservative case: fragmented programme versions retain 9/10 lookup hours, missing identity integration retains 14/15 registration hours and the bespoke recommendation retains all 10 writing hours: 98 retained, 2 gross minus 2 =0. Compatible course and student identifiers retain 8 lookup, 11 registration and 9 recommendation hours plus 65 fixed hours: 93 retained, 7 gross minus 2 =5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on academic and administrative committees

steps.what: Locate committee papers and read the institutional issues
Write the member's contribution on policies, departmental matters or academic issues
Send the member contribution to the committee
Serve in committee deliberations and exercise the member's judgement

tasks.design: Use a native {DOCS} committee paper view and a contribution template that carries agenda references. The teacher still reads the papers, writes her position, sends the checked contribution and participates in committee deliberation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating papers and restating agenda context can consume preparation effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document views and reusable agenda headings can remove a limited amount of navigation and formatting.
tasks.still_hard: Policy trade-offs and departmental interests require accountable deliberation.
tasks.human_edge: Represent experience, challenge assumptions and exercise judgement with other members.
tasks.altitude: Improve preparation without delegating committee membership.

reach.learn: Maintain current agenda references and document versions.

evidence.claim: Native paper views and agenda-linked headings could reduce limited preparation work; committee judgement and these time estimates are not measured.

assumptions: The scenario concerns committees where members already submit written contributions that colleagues read. No secretariat minutes, new attendance log or trailing record is added.

The committee administrator produces the agenda, paper versions and recipients in current committee administration. S1 includes checking completeness and reading; missing papers require manual retrieval. The member produces her position in s2.
The paper view removes 2 hours of navigation, not reading. The contribution template removes 3 hours of repeated agenda references and formatting, not policy argument.
No proposal is uploaded to a model. Ordinary document saves retain their existing small time without self-approval.
unknowns: Whether this committee currently uses written member contributions.
Whether agenda links already make papers easy to locate.
research_questions: Observe committee preparation and separate locating, reading, argument writing and formatting time.

already_counted.description: Read committee evidence and write the substantive member position

incremental.description: Maintain the paper view and agenda heading format

approvals.approved_version: Exact member contribution, attachments and committee recipients; a changed version or recipient list requires checking again before sending.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=95, gross 5 minus 1 upkeep gives central net 4. Conservative case: weak paper metadata retain all 20 paper hours and only reusable headings save 1 of 20 contribution hours: 99 retained, 1 gross minus 1 =0. A compatible agenda view retains 19 paper and 18 contribution hours plus 60 fixed hours: 97 retained, 3 gross minus 1 =2. Existing oral-only participation provides no invented writing benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Check campus and community event details and the requested role
outputs: understood event time, venue and role

steps.what: Prepare any material already required for event participation
inputs: understood event time, venue and role

steps.what: Participate in campus and community events and engage with attendees

tasks.design: Use a native {CALENDAR} event view and reusable existing {DOCS} programme material for preparation. Participation and attendee conversations remain human; no post-event activity record is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the event details and reformatting existing programme material can add minor preparation work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing calendar views and document formats can reduce those particular preparation actions.
tasks.still_hard: Presence and responsive engagement are the purpose of attending.
tasks.human_edge: Connect with attendees and respond to their immediate interests.
tasks.altitude: Prepare efficiently and remain personally present at events.

reach.learn: Reuse verified programme material without replacing personal engagement.

evidence.claim: Native calendar views and reusable event material could remove a little preparation effort; attendance and relationship work remain fully retained.

assumptions: The task covers current event preparation and attendance. S2 exists only where material is already required and read or presented at the event; no attendance report or follow-up record is invented.

The organiser produces date, venue, programme and requested role in the invitation. S1 includes reading and checking these details; uncertain information requires clarification rather than inferred structured fields.

Calendar consolidation removes only 1 hour of repeated detail lookup. Reusing existing programme formatting removes 3 hours from preparation while the teacher retains content selection and adaptation.
The interaction gate checks the actual material and statements presented to the current audience, not the author's internal save.
unknowns: Whether participation requires prepared material today.
Whether invitations already supply a single current calendar entry.
research_questions: Time existing event preparation and attendance, counting no new reporting work.

already_counted.description: Adapt event material and engage with attendees

approvals.approved_version: Exact event material and statements used with the current attendees; the teacher checks changed facts before presenting them.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=96, gross 4 minus 1 upkeep gives central net 3. Conservative case: invitations still require full 10-hour checking and little reusable material retains 14/15 preparation hours, plus 75 attendance hours: 99 retained, 1 gross minus 1 =0. A usable event entry retains 9.5 checking hours and a compatible existing material format retains 12.5 preparation hours, plus 75 attendance hours: 97 retained, 3 gross minus 1 =2. Events needing no preparation material supply no such writing benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep education relationships and institutional judgement with teachers while reducing specific preparation and entry work.
reach: Coordinate source information with registration staff and committee administrators.
skills_to_grow: Native document and student record views
role.ambitious_version: Teachers supported by useful current materials and simple records, without adding unused reporting.
